# minimp3

Source: https://github.com/lieff/minimp3

Pinned commit: `ea99364f61c14656440e8d77e9c233ccf3124633`.
Files: unmodified `minimp3.h`, `LICENSE` (CC0-1.0).

Used only to decode MP3 generated by the speaker's native Xiaomi TTS. The native
service returned MP3 even when asked for WAV or PCM. Decoding in our owned process
allows an independently cancellable ALSA child, without stopping global stock
playback. No model authentication/provider code comes from this dependency.

`MINIMP3_ONLY_MP3`, `MINIMP3_NO_SIMD`; mono/stereo, fixed rate per sentence,
512 KiB compressed and 30-second decoded bounds. Decoder upstream test vectors
and our generated fixtures are not shipped in firmware.
